title: Triangular Resampling for Long-Horizon Motion Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.34697v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce Triangular Resampling (TR), a post-training method for mitigating long-horizon error accumulation in motion diffusion models. Built on FloodDiffusion's triangular denoising schedule, TR addresses the mismatch between ground-truth-derived training windows and model-generated inference states. Replacing only completed motion history leaves this mismatch unresolved in partially denoised states within the active window. TR therefore extends rollout-based training to these states, using ground-truth clamping to limit excessive drift. For each replayed sample, TR draws one denoising threshold, shared across latent positions and replay updates, and replays multi-step triangular denoising without gradient tracking. After each update, states below the threshold are replaced with noise-matched ground truth, while those at or above it retain model predictions. The resulting latent window enters the standard training update. T

translated_title: 用于长时程运动生成的三角重采样
translated_abstract: 我们提出三角重采样（TR），这是一种用于缓解运动扩散模型中长时程误差累积的后训练方法。TR构建于FloodDiffusion的三角去噪调度之上，旨在解决由真值推导的训练窗口与模型生成的推理状态之间的不匹配问题。仅替换已完成的运动历史无法解决活动窗口内部分去噪状态中的这种不匹配。因此，TR将基于滚动展开的训练扩展到这些状态，并利用真值钳制来限制过度漂移。对于每个重放样本，TR抽取一个去噪阈值，该阈值在所有潜在位置和重放更新之间共享，并在无梯度跟踪的情况下重放多步三角去噪。每次更新后，低于阈值的状态被替换为与噪声水平匹配的真值，而处于或高于阈值的状态则保留模型预测。由此得到的潜在窗口进入标准训练更新。
tldr: 提出三角重采样（TR）后训练方法，通过对部分去噪状态进行带真值钳制的多步去噪重放训练，有效缓解运动扩散模型在长时程生成中的误差累积问题。
en_tdlr: Triangular Resampling (TR) is a post-training method that extends rollout-based training to partially denoised states with ground-truth clamping, mitigating long-horizon error accumulation in motion diffusion models.
